flaws: In the UI info card, the subtitle string is missing a separator and has an awkward line break: '6.92 s flight Landing error 0.014 m.' should have a bullet or period between 'flight' and 'Landing'.
The 3D text labels ('GATE 1', 'GATE 2', 'GATE 3', 'LAND') intersect with geometry or overlap each other in the 'low' and 'chase' camera views, hurting visual legibility.
The flight path tube is very thin and lacks shadows or vertical drop-lines to the floor grid, making depth perception of the trajectory difficult in the overview and top-down views.
In the 'chase' camera view, the 'GATE 3' 3D label clips directly behind the translucent UI overlay card on the left.
parsed.summary: Excellent engineering and visual execution. Achieving 16/16 validation passes in strong gusty wind with a fast 6.92s flight time, smooth trajectory, and 0.014m landing error is outstanding. The clean architectural aesthetic works very well, with only minor typographic and 3D label occlusion flaws holding it back from perfection.
